# Framework Mappings

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_mappings.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every DSB rule maps to recognized industry guidance. The mappings are authored
inline in [`SKILL.md`](../SKILL.md) §3 and inverted here so a framework control can be
traced to the DSB rules that carry it.

```text
Industry Standards / Best Practices
              ↓
DSB DevSecOps Engineering Methodology
              ↓
DSB Rules
              ↓
Organizational Context
              ↓
Platform / Tool Implementation
```

Frameworks **inform** the DSB methodology. They do not replace engineering
judgment, and a mapping is not a claim of certification or full coverage of
the referenced framework.

## Coverage

| Framework | Controls referenced | DSB rules citing it |
|---|---|---|
| NIST SSDF | 18 | 39 |
| SLSA | 4 | 13 |
| OWASP SAMM | 3 | 5 |
| OWASP CI/CD | 8 | 17 |
| CNCF | 7 | 12 |
